notes: MAINT-BRAIN stories created with full lifecycle coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for GPTReader + manifest interaction
Added core logic reliability enhancements for GPTReader
Added API layer for controlled GPTReader access and manifest usage
Added unit and integration test coverage for GPTReader and manifest
Added integration with audit logging and Brain runner
change_log.note: Ensure audit consistency across Brain operations

MAINT-BRAIN-S1.title: Define GPTReader and Manifest Schema Contracts
MAINT-BRAIN-S1.description: Define strict schema and contract for GPTReader queries and responses, including manifest lookup structure, response size limits (500KB), document caps (100), and audit fields to ensure consistent interaction patterns.

MAINT-BRAIN-S2.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Constraint Enforcement
MAINT-BRAIN-S2.description: Enhance GPTReader core logic to enforce query limits, handle partial failures, ensure consistent pagination, validate manifest references, and gracefully degrade when limits or data gaps are encountered.

MAINT-BRAIN-S3.title: Expose Controlled GPTReader Access API
MAINT-BRAIN-S3.description: Provide a controlled internal API layer for GPTReader usage that enforces authentication, manifest-based access patterns, and standardized request/response handling for Brain components.

MAINT-BRAIN-S4.title: Build GPTReader and Manifest Test Suite
MAINT-BRAIN-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests covering schema validation, limit enforcement, manifest lookup correctness, error handling, and edge cases such as large responses and missing records.

MAINT-BRAIN-S5.title: Integrate GPTReader with Audit Logging and Brain Runner
MAINT-BRAIN-S5.description: Ensure all GPTReader interactions are consistently logged with audit metadata and integrated with Brain runner workflows, including traceability of manifest usage and query decisions.

MAINT-BRAIN.mitigation: Enforce strict response limits and schema validation already defined in GPTReader to prevent uncontrolled behavior.
